cohort: 732 trichorionic and 118 dichorionic triplet pregnancies after IVF/ICSI cycles between October 1999 and May 2014 at the Reproductive & Genetic Hospital of CITIC-Xiangya.
finding: Multifetal pregnancy reduction (MFPR) in dichorionic and trichorionic triplet pregnancies was associated with a lower miscarriage rate and higher live birth and take home baby rates compared to expectant management.
